entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 7B Q4_K_M v8 plus rejected provisional ASUS terminology instruction
entries.expected_invariant: A terminology hint must not change a target's processor count, mouse accessory referent, amount or negation when the hinted term is absent or negated.
entries.last_outcome: Target absence/negation/mention isolation passes exact v8 byte checks and both original positives repair; variant rejected after new contrast referent loss and unclear negative accessory terms. Product v8 unchanged.
